study.question: Does changing taskwise versus aggregate auxiliary-context centering, independently of collecting click context derivatives in one joint VJP, explain why the latest nominal centered replay failed to reproduce earlier click AUC?
study.hypothesis: The g3-r0039 refactor changed both task-gradient collection and click-gradient collection. For a fixed occupancy mask, C(g)=occupied*(g-occupied_mean(g)) is linear in exact arithmetic, so sum_t C(g_t)=C(sum_t g_t). The task/direct reconstruction and aggregate/joint replay therefore have the same nominal first-order context map. Their actual finite-precision graph execution can differ, possibly explaining the observed -0.0007307577328427 replay AUC change. A 2x2 replacement factorial will localize a task-scope effect, a click-collection effect, their interaction, or neither. Numerical causation is provisional until host gradients and updates are compared; a different historical centering implementation remains an alternative.

study.proposed_difference: Implement two training-only architecture metadata choices: centering_scope=task|aggregate and click_context_collection=direct|joint. Task scope wraps each of the three auxiliary product-context input edges with a unary centered VJP. Aggregate/direct wraps their common auxiliary context input once while click bypasses it. Joint collection captures click and auxiliary cotangents together; task/joint passes already-centered task cotangents without recentering, whereas aggregate/joint uses the inherited centered replay. At fixed state all forward values, private task derivatives, labels, loss, buffers and parameter counts are intended to match. These prescribed VJPs are not derivatives of their identity forward maps.
predictions: aggregate_joint should reproduce g3-r0039-centered_replay AUC0.6676314512972833 and its four-task metrics under the identical frozen seed, subject to host determinism; failure blocks cross-implementation attribution.

If the two collection changes account for the older discrepancy, task_direct should move toward g3-r0038-centered_aligned AUC0.668362209030126. Exact historical recovery is not promised because that source is unavailable.

At common model state, all four cells have identical forward values, losses, private module gradients and Dice updates within measured numeric tolerance. Differences should first appear in accumulated shared context gradients or updates; host must record where.

A consistent task-scope contrast at both click-collection levels implicates task summation/centering placement; a consistent click-collection contrast at both centering levels implicates click-path collection. A nonadditive interaction rejects a one-factor account.
No cell should change model capacity or inference execution. Extra centering reductions may alter training cost; measure full-unit wall/GPU time rather than claiming equal compute.
falsifiers: If aggregate_joint fails common-state equivalence or fails to replay the latest control, stop mechanism interpretation and investigate implementation/execution rather than calling it scientific counterevidence.
If task_direct does not recover any of the earlier loss in AUC and the intermediate cells do not localize an effect, the two-change reconstruction explanation is unsupported.
If forward values, private gradients, labels, mask behavior, initialization or state differ, the intended collection-only contrast is invalid.

If shared context/scattered gradients and first updates agree at measured precision across all four cells, an immediate numerical-gradient explanation is not supported; later scheduling or another historical implementation difference remains open.
A preliminary direction difference within g3-r0039 cannot establish task interference once its aligned bridge failed; no new reflection mechanism claim will be made from those cross-lineage results.
alternative_explanations: Earlier taskwise centering may have used a different mask, arithmetic order, or dtype from this reconstruction; exact earlier source is not available.
Sparse/shared embedding IDs and gradient accumulation order may amplify small numerical differences; clipping and Adagrad can propagate them without changing the mathematical objective.
BF16 forward/backward kernel dispatch, GPU nondeterminism or a host execution difference may contribute; the context tensor itself may be FP32 and must have its actual dtype recorded.
One frozen initialization, validation-selection reuse and small AUC contrasts are insufficient for repeated support; deterministic replays are not independent seeds.
Auxiliary label semantics are user/category/brand24h outcomes, not ad conversion attribution; official_offline future maturity assumptions limit production transfer.

In diagnostic copies activate the inherited zero-initialized output layers so auxiliary context derivatives are nonzero. At identical weights, compare each task product-context incoming cotangent, its FP32 C, their sum, the aggregate C, original click context contributions, the merged context gradient, coalesced shared-ID embedding gradients and one optimizer update. Record actual dtypes, max absolute/relative errors and norms separately in FP32 and frozen BF16. Native BF16 differences are observations, not grounds to alter precision/optimizer. Report errors rather than presupposing bitwise equivalence.

If it fails, withhold causal interpretation of all historical reflection comparisons. Forward or private-gradient mismatches invalidate any cell, even if its AUC improves.
